high_fanout_review.note: Connected-object counts include the clock port; only the clock net was returned in each of the six designs.

warning_review.ELAB-311: The two-bit result selector covers every value; its defensive default cannot be reached.
warning_review.VER-318: Reviewed explicit product sign extension and nonnegative parameter/counter comparisons. Directed signed-edge and random tests pass.
warning_review.LINT-1: Unused elaboration intermediates removed by optimization; no public result output is discarded in the tested behavior.
warning_review.LINT-28: Unconnected constant or unused DesignWare arithmetic ports.
warning_review.LINT-31: Shared constant/control connections, including even tile-coordinate low bits and FIFO controls.
warning_review.LINT-33: Repeated arithmetic input connections after optimization.
warning_review.LINT-52: Tile coordinates advance by two; their low bits are constant zero.
warning_review.TIM-134: Reopened the six first-seed mapped designs: clk was the sole net above threshold 1000. Clock distribution remains ideal.
warning_review.UCN-1: Generated Verilog naming for nets shared between ports.
warning_review.VO-4: The generated Verilog writer emits assign/tran constructs; mapped-netlist equivalence was not performed.

measurement_scope: Full GEMM core including controllers, FIFOs, and register-based memories. Compute time is accepted-start through done; power and energy cover external load, compute, and readback. Primary high-effort power.rpt fields supply numerical values; low-effort hierarchy power is not summed into graph data.
limitations: Pre-layout wire-load estimates and RTL SAIF, without extracted routing, physical clock tree, or gate-delay glitch activity.
Educational SAED32 RVT typical corner, 1.05 V, 25 C; dense uniform signed INT8 workload.
No SRAM macros, retiming, added clock gating, maximum-frequency sweep, formal or gate-level equivalence, FPGA or silicon measurements.
64x64 values are conditional extrapolations; no 64x64 RTL simulation or synthesis was performed.
Power seed ranges and model-choice sensitivity spans are not confidence intervals.
